verdict.rationale: Origin, in early beta, is Cursor's own git forge. Teams can create repos, mirror GitHub repos, browse and search code, and share with their Cursor team, which gives the repo half of a shared source of truth. Nothing in the evidence shows a shared workspace built from team docs or that combines docs and repos. Project rules and skills that encode codebase knowledge are related features, not a shared workspace. Missing for 10: ingesting docs into a shared workspace, one unified docs-plus-repos team workspace, a capability beyond early beta, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: you can create repos, push and pull with git, mirror from GitHub, browse and search code, open and merge pull requests, and share with your Cursor team.
Cursor's git forge for storing and sharing code
